content.text: Only PHP projects can reference a PHP class. Let me run a precise search with a boundary so `SessionInterface`/`SessionBagInterface` etc. are excluded, across all non-symfony members with the required directory exclusions.

input.command:
cd /Users/ethanhinson/dev/code-indexer/bench/repos
for d in client_golang drupal flask laravel-framework nest prometheus werkzeug; do
  rg -l --no-ignore -g '!vendor/**' -g '!node_modules/**' -g '!dist/**' -g '!build/**' \
    'HttpFoundation\\Session\\Session([^A-Za-z0-9_\\]|$)' "$d" 2>/dev/null
done | sort
input.description: Find files referencing the Session class, boundary-aware, excluding build dirs
